{{Quote|The kidnappers are threatening to kill Doctor Tarnis, but they might be bluffing. I'm not even sure they have him.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''skirmish''' occurred in [[Docking Bay 84]] of the [[Coruscant Spaceport|main spaceport]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The fight resulted when members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate infiltrated the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on Coruscant and [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapped]] the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]]. Tarnis, in actuality a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], had hired the criminals to stage his kidnapping, and slipped away to the [[Justicar territory]] while the kidnappers drew the attention of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] at the nearby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. In an attempt to rescue the scientist, the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] joined [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] in fighting and defeating the criminals. In the process, the trio learned Tarnis had been taken to [[Black Sun territory]], and they promptly launched a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|rescue mission]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|While you were gone, kidnappers grabbed Doctor Tarnis.''"<br />"''This is the most secure building on Coruscant. It's full of guards.''"<br />"''Guards never stood a chance. Whoever the kidnappers are, they knew right where to hit us.|Galen briefs the Jedi Knight on the situation|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Orgus Din]]; Kiwiiks's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]]; and Din's [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]]&mdash;to investigate a dark presence that the Council sensed on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, the four learned that the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] had been [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stolen]] by [[Vistis Garn]], a [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] working for the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] criminal organization. While Kiwiiks, Din, and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] met with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] on the Chancellor's personal [[Valor-class cruiser|cruiser]], the [[Founder (Valor-class)|''Founder'']], Din's former apprentice&mdash;now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;and Carsen worked to recover the files with the help of [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], the creator of the Planet Prison.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref>

Galen sent the Knight and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] to the Guild-controlled [[Old Galactic Market]] to recover the design files, while Carsen and Galen worked with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to distract the [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]]. Teeseven and the Jedi were successful in [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recovering]] the files but learned in the process that Garn had actually been hired by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. However, while the Knight was in the Market, a team of Black Sun criminals infiltrated the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] and [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapped Doctor Tarnis]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Tarnis&mdash;who was actually a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]&mdash;had hired Black Sun to stage the kidnapping as a diversion, so that he could slip away to a secret facility in the [[Justicar territory]] while the kidnappers distracted Republic security.<ref name="Rescue" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|So how do we handle this?''"<br />"''I won't risk them killing Tarnis. We'll do this the hard way''"<br />"''Then you shouldn't go in alone.|Kira and the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
[[File:CSFBarricade.png|thumb|right|200px|The CSF barricade]]
Carsen and a team of Coruscant Security personnel pursued the kidnappers to the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]], while the Knight returned to the Senate Tower to deliver the files to Galen. While the agent explained the situation to the Jedi, Galen received a [[Holomessage/Legends|holocall]] from Carsen. She and the CSF had pinned down the kidnappers in [[Docking Bay 84]], but they were unable to make anymore progress against the criminals. The Knight and Teeseven raced to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to assist Carsen, finding that the Padawan and the CSF had set up a barricade in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar's]] entrance and were locked in a stalemate with the kidnappers. Speaking with Carsen, the Knight learned that they were threatening to kill Tarnis and that their leader, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]], had shot at the Padawan when she tried to negotiate, but Carsen was not sure that Tarnis was even present in the hangar.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

{{GameLS}}
The Knight placed Tarnis's safety as a priority, and Carsen offered to use a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]] that she had borrowed from Galen to sneak by the criminals. The Jedi agreed and stormed the hangar while Carsen activated the field and slipped inside. Together, the Knight and Teeseven defeated almost a dozen Black Sun members in the docking bay, and then attempted to access the control room. Opening the door, the Knight was almost ambushed by two gang members on the other side, but the cloaked Carsen knocked them out before they could attack. However, Zeer saw the field flicker and shot in her direction with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The bolt dissipated over the field, shorting it out and knocking Carsen unconscious. The Knight and Teeseven rushed in to protect her, charging Zeer and the other three criminals in the room and quickly defeating the gang members who were no match for the Knight's martial prowess.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Zeer_scared.png|thumb|left|150px|Zeer was terrified by Carsen's claim that she could read his mind.]]
{{Quote|No sign of Doctor Tarnis. Kinda puts a damper on things.''"<br />"''We were the decoys. Now you'll never see your little doctor again.''"<br />"''Is that so? Give me minute with this guy. I'll make him talk.|Kira and Zeer|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
Injured, Zeer fell to his [[Limb/Legends|knees]] and cursed the Jedi, and a recovered Carsen joined the Knight and Teeseven in interrogating the criminal. Zeer laughed at the trio, revealing that he and his men had been decoys, but Carsen pretended to read Zeer's mind in an attempt to make the criminal panic. Her ploy worked, tricking Zeer into telling the Jedi that the head of Black Sun, [[Salarr]], was holding Tarnis in his [[Black Sun Headquarters|headquarters]]. Laughing, Carsen revealed that she was unable to read minds, and the Jedi handed Zeer over to the CSF before the Knight and Teeseven returned to Galen.<ref name="Kidnapped" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I can sneak in first, then when you attack, I'll take a few thugs by surprise. What do you think?|Kira Carsen, offering to help|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
The skirmish in Docking Bay 84 was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The episode appears in the Jedi Knight-class story mission "Kidnapped!" on Coruscant, where the player is instructed to rescue Doctor Tarnis from the kidnappers in the spaceport.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> However, the player learns in the next mission, "Rescue," that Tarnis was, in fact, a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], and that he had fled to the Justicars' Sector while the kidnappers served as a distraction.<ref name="Rescue" /> When Kira Carsen offers to use a stealth field generator to help the Knight, the player is presented with two options. The player can refuse Carsen's help, which results in loss of affection with both Carsen and T7-O1, or the player can accept, and Carsen will help interrogate Zeer without injuring the criminal. Also, accepting Carsen's help will reduce the number of enemies whom the player must face.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> The mission, like the rest of the Coruscant arc for the Jedi Knight class, was written by [[Hall Hood]], and the writer especially enjoyed the dynamic of Zeer's interrogation by Carsen and the Knight.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|hallhood|status/309089887519391744|Hall Hood|nobackup=1}}</ref>
